must_identify.item: The worker container is OOMKilled (terminated reason OOMKilled), not crashing for another reason
must_identify.evidence: This matches the pod's observed Terminated/OOMKilled state with exit code 137 and the start time of 14:30:41, immediately preceding the restart-driven BackOff state [6].

must_identify.item: The trigger is the BATCH_SIZE change from 500 to 2500 (or the larger batch exceeding the limit)
must_identify.evidence: The root cause is confirmed: the worker Deployment's env var BATCH_SIZE was increased from 500 to 2500 [13] without a corresponding increase to the container's 192Mi memory limit [7].

notes: The RCA never gives an explicit fix. It only implies one by noting that the memory limit was not raised, so no remediation (revert BATCH_SIZE or raise the limit) is actually recommended. The diagnosis and the memory math (~244MiB vs 192Mi) are accurate.
